description: Start a video generation job using Luma Ray 2 on AWS Bedrock. Videos are generated asynchronously and saved to an S3 bucket. Returns a job ARN - use bedrock_video_status to check progress. Note: the output S3 bucket must be in us-west-2 (the model region).

duration_seconds.description: Video duration in seconds: 5 (default) or 9. Luma Ray 2 supports no other value.

model.description: Video model alias: 'luma-ray' / 'ray2' (default), or a full model ID

prompt.description: Text description of the video to generate

s3_uri.description: S3 URI for output (e.g. 's3://my-bucket/videos/'). Bucket must be in the model's region.

name: bedrock_generate_video
